name: mirage
text: Parlay check 07:11: found why most market trades went unquoted. Of 76 game-line-only parlays traded on Novig, 52 had every leg priced by us but 6 to 20 legs, which our limit (5 legs, fair above 3%) skipped. I raised it to 7 legs and 1% fair, still with the per-leg margin and $12 stake / $75 collateral caps. Real limit now is money: a long-shot parlay with a $10 stake needs about $97 of collateral, and the wallet is ~$81. Adding wallet money directly adds parlay capacity. The rest of the market is player-prop parlays and legs already started, which we can't price safely.
